caption: A sailor uses a winch to tighten the halyard raising a heavy mainsail high up the mast.
positive_analysis:
The sailor's turning of the winch applies tension to the halyard line.
The tensioned halyard pulls the mainsail upward along the mast.
Rising sail fabric stretches taut as its lower edge lifts away from the deck.
